summary: Frontend-only investor regression completed on public preview URL. Verified five-act rail navigation/active state, Act I-V copy+interaction refinements, Act III nine-scene demo sync and channel click behavior, Act IV mode panels/commercial wedge content, Act V evidence views, CTA usability, responsive rail visibility rules, reduced-motion usability, and no horizontal overflow. Enterprise scenario data remains MOCKED/MODELED.
critical_code_review_comments: InvestorActRail IDs and testids are uniquely mapped and scroll landing aligns correctly to each act section at desktop 1920x800.
Act II beat/status progression is present as required (CHAT -> OPERATIONS -> GOVERNED) when sampled at finer scroll intervals.
Critical interaction testids verified unique/present for rail, mode tabs, evidence tabs, guided run, channel tab, and closing CTAs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Current public build resolves prior channel-click interception and prior max-depth console issue was not reproduced in this run (including guided-run stress sequence). If future regressions appear, retest with slower/stepwise scroll sampling for Act II and avoid mid-transition assertions during framer-motion mode swaps.
rca of the issue: No confirmed product defect in this iteration. Two intermediate failures were test-method artifacts: (1) Act rail overshoot check used section-center heuristic unsuitable for sticky/tall sections; corrected to scroll alignment check. (2) Act IV wedge count sampled during panel transition window, causing transient zero count before content mounted.
